basic.description:
{Basic Resistance}

Basic Resistance reduces damage from spells inflicted against the hero's troops by 15%.

advanced.description:
{Basic Resistance}

Basic Resistance reduces damage from spells inflicted against the hero's troops by 30%.

expert.description:
{Basic Resistance}

Basic Resistance reduces damage from spells inflicted against the hero's troops by 40%.

basic.description:
{Basic Logistics}

Basic Logistics increases your hero's movement points over land by 5%.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Logistics}

Advanced Logistics increases your hero's movement points over land by 10%.

expert.description:
{Expert Logistics}

Expert Logistics increases your hero's movement points over land by 20%.

basic.description:
{Basic Scouting}

Basic Scouting allows your hero to see 1 square further into the shroud.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Scouting}

Advanced Scouting allows your hero to see 3 squares further into the shroud.

expert.description:
{Expert Scouting}

Expert Scouting allows your hero to see 5 squares further into the shroud.

basic.description:
{Basic Necromancy}

Basic Necromancy allows 5% of the creatures killed in combat to be brought back from the dead as Skeletons.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Necromancy}

Advanced Necromancy allows 10% of the creatures killed in combat to be brought back from the dead as Skeletons.

expert.description:
{Expert Necromancy}

Expert Necromancy allows 15% of the creatures killed in combat to be brought back from the dead as Skeletons.

basic.description:
{Basic Estates}

Your hero contributes 250 gold per day to your cause.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Estates}

Your hero contributes 500 gold per day to your cause.

expert.description:
{Expert Estates}

Your hero contributes 1000 gold per day to your cause.

basic.description:
{Basic Intelligence}

Basic Intelligence increases a hero's normal maximum spell points by 20%.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Intelligence}

Advanced Intelligence increases a hero's normal maximum spell points by 40%.

expert.description:
{Expert Intelligence}

Expert Intelligence increases a hero's normal maximum spell points by 60%.

basic.description:
{Basic Sorcery}

Causes a hero's spells to inflict an additional 10% damage in combat.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Sorcery}

Causes a hero's spells to inflict an additional 20% damage in combat.

expert.description:
{Expert Sorcery}

Causes a hero's spells to inflict an additional 30% damage in combat.

basic.description:
{Basic Mysticism}

Advanced Mysticism allows your hero to regenerate 5 spell points per day.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Mysticism}

Advanced Mysticism allows your hero to regenerate 15 spell points per day.

expert.description:
{Expert Mysticism}

Advanced Mysticism allows your hero to regenerate 30 spell points per day.

basic.description:
{Basic Learning}

Increases hero's earned experience by 25% and knowledge by 1.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Learning}

Increases hero's earned experience by 50% and magical primary skills by 1.

expert.description:
{Expert Learning}

Increases hero's earned experience by 75% and all primary skills by 1.

basic.description:
{Basic Ballistics}

 Gives the hero control of the Catapult. The Catapult can be aimed, has an increased chance to hit fortifications and 50% chance for double damage. Health points of the Catapult are increased by 250.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Ballistics}

 Gives the hero control of the Catapult. The Catapult can be aimed, always hits the intended target, shoots twice and has 50% chance for double damage. Health points of the Catapult are increased by 500.

expert.description:
{Expert Ballistics}

 Gives the hero control of the Catapult. The Catapult can be aimed, always hits the intended target, shoots twice and always deals double damage.  Health points of the Catapult are increased by 1000.

basic.description:
{Basic First Aid}

 Gives the hero control of the First Aid Tent. The First Aid Tent heals the first unit in a stack for 50 points of damage and removes negative effects. Health points of the First Aid Tent are increased by 25 and damage it obtains from spells is reduced by 50%.

advanced.description:
{Advanced First Aid}

 Gives the hero control of the First Aid Tent. The First Aid Tent heals the first unit in a stack for 75 points of damage and removes negative effects. Health points of the First Aid Tent are increased by 50 and damage it obtains from spells is reduced by 75%.

expert.description:
{Expert First Aid}

 Gives the hero control of the First Aid Tent. The First Aid Tent heals the first unit in a stack for 100 points of damage and removes negative effects. Health points of the First Aid Tent are increased by 75 and damage it obtains from spells is reduced by 100%.

basic.description:
{Basic Artillery}

 Gives the hero control of the Ballista and Arrow Towers. The Ballista has a 50% chance to inflict 200% base Damage. Health points of the Ballista are increased by 50.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Artillery}

 Gives the hero control of the Ballista and Arrow Towers. The Ballista shoots twice and has a 75% chance to inflict 200% base Damage. Health points of the Ballista are increased by 100.

expert.description:
{Expert Artillery}

 Gives the hero control of the Ballista and Arrow Towers. The Ballista shoots twice and inflicts 200% base Damage. Health points of the Ballista are increased by 250.
